name: Casual table etiquette
notes: What the casual profile treats as feel-bad. 'avoid' cards are cut from the casual version and never suggested for it; 'penalize' cards are allowed but scored down by their weight (0-1). Patterns are regexes over lowercased rules text with reminder text removed. 'gameChangers' uses Scryfall's Game Changer flag (the Commander list of format-warping cards).

gameChangers.reason: on the Commander Game Changers list

rules.name: extra turns
rules.pattern: takes? an extra turn|extra turn after this one

rules.name: mass land destruction
rules.pattern: destroy all (?:nonbasic )?lands|each player sacrifices (?:all|\w+) lands|destroy all permanents

rules.name: lock pieces
rules.pattern: (?:your opponents|each opponent|players) can't cast (?!spells during your turn)|can't untap during|spells your opponents cast cost \{\d\} more|players can't search|skip (?:their|your) untap step

rules.name: no spells on your turn
rules.pattern: can't cast spells during your turn

rules.name: mass discard
rules.pattern: each (?:opponent|player) discards (?:their|his or her) hand|discards? their hand

rules.name: hand attack
rules.pattern: target (?:opponent|player) reveals their hand[^.]*discards|target opponent discards
